text: 据上交所发布，2026年9月14日至2026年9月18日，上交所对50起拉抬打压、虚假申报等证券异常交易行为采取了自律监管措施，对龙版传媒等波动幅度较大的股票进行重点监控，对33起上市公司重大事项等进行专项核查，向证监会上报涉嫌违法违规案件线索2起。
text_en: According to the Shanghai Stock Exchange, from September 14, 2026 to September 18, 2026, the SSE took self-regulatory measures against 50 cases of abnormal securities trading behavior such as ramping up and suppressing prices and false declarations, focused monitoring on stocks with relatively large fluctuations such as Longban Media, conducted special verification of 33 major matters of listed companies, and reported 2 suspected illegal and irregular case clues to the CSRC.
